answer: A crystal-clear bonding registry gates agent entry. Each identity deposits D=200 tokens locked for 30 epochs; the harbor of registration rotates the stake into a unique slot, so clone creation doubles cost C(n)=D*2^n. A lantern-style beacon audit re-verifies every slot quarterly, and proof v=H(slot||nonce)<T with p=0.999. Sybil clones cannot share one slot.
